daily.brief: 從11月12日凌晨到13日上午，市場有837則帖、176個帳號在討論。最大焦點是$NVDA，391則帖裡面看淡帳號明顯多過看好（30對15），但有人強調以約10倍預期盈利交易已經便宜，而且客戶不會取消訂單。共識最乾淨的是AMD（11個看好、零看淡）同AMAT（9個）。MSFT因為Outlook中斷被點名，SMCI則因為調查相關被看淡。
daily.full:
共識

AMD是這段最乾淨的共識，11個帳號看好、沒有看淡，35則帖。@BrianSozzi再次恭喜年度CEO @LisaSu。原帖。@3PeaksTrading指出月初以17.77美元買入的$AMD 2月看漲價差現在報價42.50美元。原帖。@OptionsMike提到市場守住，AMD大幅波動，AAPL創新高。原帖。

AMAT也有9個帳號一致看好，16則帖。@BarbarianCap提到因半導體需求銷售和利潤上升。原帖。@tenet_research指出CEO提到創紀錄的FY26業績，預計半導體系統在2026日曆年增長超過40%。原帖。@TheTranscript_報導財年第四季收入同比增加53%，非GAAP EPS增加92%。原帖。

SPY有7個帳號看好。@alphaticaio說他們將試圖在NVDA之前將此推高至SPX 7700。原帖。@RyanDetrick認為這仍然是牛市。原帖。@Bluekurtic指出標普500進入一年中最強的15天季節性窗口之一，過去31年中有27年上漲。原帖。

共同看淡

MSFT有5個帳號看淡，21則帖，主要是服務中斷。@KeithMcCullough提到Microsoft仍在經歷電子郵件服務中斷。原帖。@GerberKawasaki說Microsoft Outlook仍然宕機，自上午10點起。原帖。@damnang2覺得情況看起來比想像更嚴重。原帖。

SMCI有3個帳號看淡。@unusual_whales指出司法部正在調查與Alice Huang（Nvidia醜聞中心的女性）有關的公司是否幫助將Super Micro產品走私到中國。原帖。@wallstengine報導$SMCI下跌13%，據彭博，美國正調查Alice Huang是否協助透過Super Micro走私NVIDIA動力伺服器。原帖。@KeithMcCullough說根據Hedgeye，$SMCI仍然是看跌趨勢。原帖。

分歧

NVDA是絕對主角，391則帖，看好15個帳號、看淡30個。@paola_rojas表示Huang可能是糟糕的配偶，但將他趕下台是錯誤的，將長期傷害股東及更廣泛的生態系統。原帖。@philrosenn指出Nvidia以約10倍預期盈利交易，較幾乎其他所有AI股便宜：AVGO 17倍、TSMC 18倍、GOOG 19倍、AMD 33倍。原帖。但看淡聲音較多，@fundstrat引述Tom Lee說：「我不認為會有任何一個Nvidia客戶取消訂單。」原帖。

CBRS偏多但有交鋒，13個看好對1個看淡。@BarbarianCap提到Cerebras因第三季度雲端收入激增上調展望。原帖。@josenajarro指出實現真正的超預期與上調指引，第三季核心收入$230.9M同比增長70%，對比市場共識$215.8M，第四季指引$310M。原帖。@StockSavvyShay報導確認$MSFT為最新超大規模客戶，將Azure加入推理合作夥伴列表。原帖。

SPCX也偏多，11對1。@BarbarianCap提到SpaceX計劃在德克薩斯和亞利桑那進行超過740億美元的數據中心投資。原帖。NBIS有8個看好對2個看淡，@moninvestor指出與IREN、CRWV的共同點是運算需求持續增長，預付款達到GPU成本的90%或以上。原帖。

其他值得留意

AAPL有6個帳號看好。@3PeaksTrading指出今日有買家購入750張2029年1月$460看漲期權，金額$2.6M，顯示長期看漲。原帖。@munster_gene說AAPL擁有穿透節日營銷噪音的超能力。原帖。QQQ有5個看好，市場守住後有逢低買入聲音。
daily.html:
短摘要

NVDA 391則帖中看淡聲音多過看好（30對15），但有人強調10倍估值便宜同訂單不會取消。AMD 11個帳號共識看好，AMAT也有9個。MSFT因中斷、SMCI因調查被看淡。837則帖、176個帳號。

weekly.brief: 過去7日（11月7日至13日）有1002則帖、186個帳號。AMD持續是最明確的共識看好，13個帳號沒有看淡。SPY、AMAT、AAPL也有支持。NVDA仍是最大熱點（435則帖）但16對30意見分裂，看淡較多。SMCI是較清楚的看淡名字。
weekly.full:
共識

AMD在這週持續獲看好，13個帳號明確支持，零看淡。SPY有9個、AMAT 9個、AAPL 6個、AVGO 5個、GOOGL 5個。整體AI相關芯片和指數有多個帳號站在多頭。@3PeaksTrading 提到AMD期權價差從17.77美元升到42.50美元。@tenet_research 指出AMAT CEO預計半導體系統2026年增長超過40%。

共同看淡

MSFT有5個帳號看淡，主要因Outlook中斷。SMCI有3個，因司法部調查Alice Huang是否協助走私NVIDIA相關產品，股價有下跌討論。

分歧

NVDA依舊最大分歧，435則帖，看好16個、看淡30個。有人認為估值以約10倍預期盈利已經便宜，客戶不會取消訂單；有人聚焦個人事件風險。CBRS、SPCX、NBIS、CSCO也有多空交錯，但多數偏多。

其他值得留意

RKLB、NU、ASTS有一些看好聲音。整體AI資本支出故事延續，但短期情緒被NVDA相關新聞干擾。
weekly.html:
短摘要

一週內AMD是最明確的共識看好（13個帳號），NVDA大分歧持續（16對30）。1002則帖中SMCI因調查被點名看淡。

monthly.brief: 過去28日（10月17日至11月13日）有5855則帖、256個帳號，討論量最大。AMD、SOFI等有較強共識看好，RDDT有9個帳號看淡。大市NVDA、SPCX、SPY、TSLA意見分裂嚴重，CRWV和INTC則偏空聲音較多。AI主題仍是主軸，但個別公司事件和估值分歧明顯。
monthly.full:
共識

AMD長期仍獲支持，16個帳號看好。SOFI有9個，AMAT 9個，SKHY 6個。一些消費和防禦股如MA、ISRG、LMT、MCD也有共識。整體有多個共識看好名字。

共同看淡

RDDT有9個帳號看淡。BA 4個、FTNT、BABA各3個。部分科技和消費名字有較一致的負面看法。

分歧

NVDA是最大分歧之一，746則帖，看好24個、看淡31個。SPCX 27對6，SPY 22對11，TSLA 24對3。有人認為AI資本支出故事未變，短期恐懼會過去；有人擔心估值和個別風險。CRWV偏空聲音較多（6看好對20看淡），INTC也是。

其他值得留意

NBIS、CBRS等AI相關持續有討論。市場輪動和個股事件影響較大，28日數據顯示共識和分歧同時存在。
monthly.html:

28日大數據中AMD等有共識，RDDT等被看淡。NVDA和SPY等大票意見分裂，AI主題延續但分歧加大。5855則帖來自256個帳號。

daily.brief: From early Nov 12 to morning of Nov 13, there were 837 posts from 176 accounts. The biggest focus is $NVDA with 391 posts where bearish accounts clearly outnumber bullish ones (30 vs 15), though some stress it trades at about 10x expected earnings and customers will not cancel orders. The cleanest consensus is AMD (11 bullish, zero bearish) and AMAT (9). MSFT is noted for an Outlook outage, while SMCI is bearish on related probes.
daily.full:
Consensus

AMD is the cleanest consensus, 11 accounts bullish with none bearish, 35 posts. @BrianSozzi again congratulates CEO of the Year @LisaSu. original post. @3PeaksTrading notes the Feb call spread bought at $17.77 early in the month is now quoting $42.50. original post. @OptionsMike says the market held, AMD was volatile, AAPL at new highs. original post.

AMAT also has 9 accounts in agreement, 16 posts. @BarbarianCap mentions sales and profits rising on semiconductor demand. original post. @tenet_research notes the CEO cited record FY26 results and expects semiconductor systems to grow over 40% in calendar 2026. original post. @TheTranscript_ reports fiscal Q4 revenue up 53% YoY and non-GAAP EPS up 92%. original post.

SPY has 7 bullish accounts. @alphaticaio says they will try to push this to SPX 7700 before NVDA. original post. @RyanDetrick still sees a bull market. original post. @Bluekurtic notes the S&P 500 is entering one of the strongest 15-day seasonal windows of the year, up in 27 of the past 31 years. original post.

Joint Bearish

MSFT has 5 bearish accounts, 21 posts, mainly on the service outage. @KeithMcCullough notes Microsoft is still experiencing email service disruptions. original post. @GerberKawasaki says Microsoft Outlook is still down since 10am. original post. @damnang2 thinks the situation looks more serious than expected. original post.

SMCI has 3 bearish accounts. @unusual_whales notes the DOJ is investigating whether companies related to Alice Huang (the woman at the center of the Nvidia scandal) helped smuggle Super Micro products to China. original post. @wallstengine reports $SMCI down 13%, citing Bloomberg that the US is investigating if Alice Huang assisted in smuggling NVIDIA-powered servers via Super Micro. original post. @KeithMcCullough says per Hedgeye, $SMCI remains in a bearish trend. original post.

Divergence

NVDA is the absolute protagonist with 391 posts, 15 bullish and 30 bearish accounts. @paola_rojas says Huang may be a bad spouse but removing him would be a mistake that hurts shareholders and the broader ecosystem long-term. original post. @philrosenn notes Nvidia trades at about 10x expected earnings, cheaper than almost all other AI stocks: AVGO 17x, TSMC 18x, GOOG 19x, AMD 33x. original post. Meanwhile @fundstrat quotes Tom Lee: "I don't think any Nvidia customer will cancel orders." original post.

CBRS leans bullish with some back-and-forth, 13 bullish vs 1 bearish. @BarbarianCap notes Cerebras raised its outlook on surging Q3 cloud revenue. original post. @josenajarro points to a true beat-and-raise, Q3 core revenue $230.9M up 70% YoY vs consensus $215.8M, Q4 guide $310M. original post. @StockSavvyShay reports confirmation of $MSFT as the latest hyperscaler customer, adding Azure to the inference partner list. original post.

SPCX also leans bullish, 11 vs 1. @BarbarianCap mentions SpaceX plans over $74 billion in data center investments in Texas and Arizona. original post. NBIS has 8 bullish vs 2 bearish, @moninvestor notes a common theme with IREN and CRWV is ongoing computing demand growth, with prepayments at 90% or more of GPU cost. original post.

Other Notable

AAPL has 6 bullish accounts. @3PeaksTrading notes a buyer bought 750 Jan 2029 $460 calls for $2.6M, showing long-term bullishness. original post. @munster_gene says AAPL has the superpower to cut through holiday marketing noise. original post. QQQ has 5 bullish voices on the market holding and dip-buying.
daily.html:
Short summary

NVDA's 391 posts show more bearish than bullish accounts (30 vs 15), but some stress the 10x valuation is cheap and orders won't be canceled. AMD has clear consensus from 11 accounts, AMAT from 9. MSFT noted for outage, SMCI for probes. 837 posts from 176 accounts.

weekly.brief: Over the past 7 days (Nov 7 to 13): 1002 posts from 186 accounts. AMD remains the clearest consensus long with 13 accounts and no bears. SPY, AMAT and AAPL also see support. NVDA is still the hottest name (435 posts) but split 16-30 with more bears. SMCI is a clearer bearish name.
weekly.full:
Consensus

AMD continued to attract bullish views with 13 accounts and zero bears. SPY has 9, AMAT 9, AAPL 6, AVGO 5, GOOGL 5. Several AI-related chip and index names have multiple accounts on the long side. @3PeaksTrading notes the AMD option spread rising from $17.77 to $42.50. @tenet_research points to AMAT CEO expecting semiconductor systems growth over 40% in 2026.

Joint Bearish

MSFT has 5 bearish accounts, mainly on the Outlook outage. SMCI has 3, on the DOJ probe into whether Alice Huang helped smuggle NVIDIA-related products, with discussion of the stock decline.

Divergence

NVDA remains the largest split with 435 posts (16 bull / 30 bear). Some focus on the ~10x expected earnings valuation being cheap and customers not canceling; others on personal event risks. CBRS, SPCX, NBIS and CSCO also show mixed takes but mostly lean bullish.

Other Notable

RKLB, NU and ASTS drew some supportive voices. The broader AI capex story continues but short-term sentiment is noisy from NVDA-related news.
weekly.html:
Short summary

AMD is the clearest consensus long over the week with 13 accounts. NVDA divergence continues (16 vs 30). 1002 posts show SMCI noted bearish on the probe.

monthly.brief: Over the past 28 days (Oct 17 to Nov 13): 5855 posts from 256 accounts. AMD and SOFI show relatively strong consensus support while RDDT draws 9 bearish accounts. Large names such as NVDA, SPCX, SPY and TSLA remain heavily split. CRWV and INTC lean more bearish. AI remains the main theme but company-specific events and valuation debates are wide.
monthly.full:
Consensus

AMD retains longer-term support with 16 accounts. SOFI has 9, AMAT 9, SKHY 6. Some consumer and defense names such as MA, ISRG, LMT and MCD also show agreement. There are multiple consensus bullish names overall.

Joint Bearish

RDDT has 9 bearish accounts. BA has 4, FTNT and BABA have 3 each. Some tech and consumer names see more aligned negative takes.

Divergence

NVDA is one of the largest splits with 746 posts (24 bull / 31 bear). SPCX 27 vs 6, SPY 22 vs 11, TSLA 24 vs 3. Some believe the AI capex story is unchanged and short-term fears will pass; others worry about valuations and specific risks. CRWV leans more bearish (6 bull vs 20 bear), as does INTC.

Other Notable

NBIS, CBRS and other AI-related names continue to draw discussion. Market rotation and company-specific events have a large impact; the 28-day data shows both consensus and divergence coexisting.
monthly.html:
Short summary

In the 28-day data AMD and others show consensus while RDDT and others are bearish. NVDA and SPY remain split. AI theme continues but divergences are wider. 5855 posts from 256 accounts.

briefing.html:
Today's Highlights

NVDA's 391 posts show more bearish than bullish accounts (30 vs 15), but some stress the ~10x expected earnings is already cheap and Tom Lee believes customers will not cancel orders. AMD draws consensus from 11 accounts with option spreads surging, AMAT from 9 on strong results. MSFT noted for Outlook outage, SMCI for probes.

Over the week and month, AMD consensus is stronger while broad market and AI leaders remain divergent. Short-term bearish voices concentrate on specific events.
